items.description_id: Ponsel lama dengan fitur dasar: pesan, panggilan, senter, radio. Baterai 長く持つ。
items.description_en: Old phone with basic features: messages, calls, flashlight, radio. Long battery life.

items.description_id: Tumpukan kwitansi pinjol online. Bunga 20% per minggu. Total 87 juta.
items.description_en: Stack of online loan receipts. 20% weekly interest. Total 87 million.

items.description_id: Kalung perak bentuk bulan sabit. Milik Joy, hadiah dari ibunya. Ditemukan di tepi hutan.
items.description_en: Silver crescent moon necklace. Joy's, gift from mother. Found at forest edge.

items.description_id: Kartu nama perusahaan fiktif. Ditemukan di saku jaket Dimas. Bukti ada cukong di balik Rudi.
items.description_en: Fictional company business card. Found in Dimas's jacket. Proof of mastermind behind Rudi.

items.description_id: Foto Joy memakai kalung bulan sabit. Diambil ibu Joy ke balai desa saat melapor hilang.
items.description_en: Photo of Joy wearing crescent necklace. Taken by Joy's mother when reporting missing.

items.description_id: Potongan struk pinjol yang robek. Berisi rincian utang dan nama penyedia: PT Mandiri Lestari.
items.description_en: Torn loan receipt pieces. Contains debt details and provider name: PT Mandiri Lestari.

items.description_id: Peta kertas dari Rudi. Titik-titik ditandai pita merah. Digunakan untuk pembakaran.
items.description_en: Paper map from Rudi. Points marked with red tape. Used for arson.

items.description_id: Amplop berisi 5 juta rupiah. Uang muka dari Rudi untuk pekerjaan membakar lahan.
items.description_en: Envelope with 5 million rupiah. Down payment from Rudi for land burning job.

items.description_id: Nasi goreng yang dimasak Raka pakai resep ibu. Masih hangat di wajan.
items.description_en: Fried rice cooked by Raka using mother's recipe. Still warm in pan.

items.description_id: Senter bawaan ponsel. Baterai terkuras pelan di malam hutan. Cahaya bulan redup saat habis.
items.description_en: Built-in phone flashlight. Battery drains slowly in night forest. Dim moonlight when empty.
